royal.name: Royal
royal.blurb: Born with a crown, died with a state funeral and a lot of paperwork.

famous.name: Famous
famous.blurb: Everybody knew your name, and nobody could remember why.

houdini.name: Houdini
houdini.blurb: The prison had a locked door, and you had the only key that mattered: charm.

deadly.name: Deadly
deadly.blurb: The coroner's office kept a special file with your name on it.

loaded.name: Loaded
loaded.blurb: You died with more money than sense, and your heirs are already fighting about it.

island_king.name: Island King
island_king.blurb: You ruled a whole island, which was mostly sand and seagulls.

jetsetter.name: Jetsetter
jetsetter.blurb: You spent more time in the air than on the ground, and your luggage agrees.

centenarian.name: Centenarian
centenarian.blurb: You outlived everyone who ever bet against you, including the actuaries.

nonagenarian.name: Nonagenarian
nonagenarian.blurb: Ninety years of opinions, most of which you held with total confidence.

rich.name: Rich
rich.blurb: Money was never a problem, except the part where you had to spend it.

lifer.name: Lifer
lifer.blurb: You were so long in prison that the guards started calling you a neighbour.

jailbird.name: Jailbird
jailbird.blurb: You served your time and left with a lot of new friends and a shiny plan.

fertile.name: Fertile
fertile.blurb: Eight children, zero quiet dinners, and a family tree that needs its own map.

family_first.name: Family First
family_first.blurb: You married once, had a crowd, and never once let anyone forget it.

scholar.name: Scholar
scholar.blurb: Your diploma outlived your handwriting, and your footnotes outlived both.

globetrotter.name: Globetrotter
globetrotter.blurb: You left home for somewhere better, then kept leaving until home was just a rumour.

heartbreaker.name: Heartbreaker
heartbreaker.blurb: Four marriages, four sets of wedding photos, and one very confused wedding planner.

career_criminal.name: Career Criminal
career_criminal.blurb: You had a rap sheet longer than your grocery list and just as organised.

survivor.name: Survivor
survivor.blurb: The illness gave you its best shot, and you gave it a very long reply.

plastic_fantastic.name: Plastic Fantastic
plastic_fantastic.blurb: You looked remarkably well for someone with so much work done.

menagerie.name: Menagerie
menagerie.blurb: Your house had more animals than neighbours, and the neighbours were not complaining.

serial_monogamist.name: Serial Monogamist
serial_monogamist.blurb: Each partner was the one, right up until the next one arrived.

gone_too_soon.name: Gone Too Soon
gone_too_soon.blurb: You left the party early, which is a tough act to follow.

unlucky.name: Unlucky
unlucky.blurb: You were dealt a bad hand at birth and never got a chance to reshuffle.

hermit.name: Hermit
hermit.blurb: You preferred a quiet house to a full calendar, and the calendar agreed.

lazy.name: Lazy
lazy.blurb: You never worked a day in your life, which is still a sort of achievement.

wasteful.name: Wasteful
wasteful.blurb: You spent every penny on things that were fun for about a week.

lone_wolf.name: Lone Wolf
lone_wolf.blurb: Nobody ever put a ring on it, mostly because you never let anyone get close.

broke.name: Broke
broke.blurb: The funeral was paid for by a crowdfunding page and a very long list of IOUs.

gearhead.name: Gearhead
gearhead.blurb: You owned a hypercar and talked about its gearbox with the sincerity of a priest.

art_patron.name: Art Patron
art_patron.blurb: You bought paintings the way other people buy socks: in bulk, and without much looking.

mediocre.name: Mediocre
mediocre.blurb: You were not great, not terrible, and the headstone is a bit disappointed in you.
